name: furnished-finder-scraper (Apify actor)
what_it_holds: An Apify-actor-wrapped scraper for Furnished Finder rental listings (travel-nurse-oriented mid-term/furnished housing marketplace). No committed data, code only, packaged for Apify's cloud-run platform. Related sibling repos from the same and other accounts: furnished-finder-fast, furnished-finder-rental-listings-scraper (AbsoluteAnchor), furnished-finder-hosts (HumbleIgnite), and a browser extension scraper (scaprisecca/furnished-finder-scraper-extension).
why_useful: A ready acquisition method for Furnished Finder mid-term-rental listing prices/host counts — the theme's named platform — though it is a scraper of a non-Airbnb site (in scope as 'method', per CONTEXT.md, left unrun).
